name: AgentCrucible
tagline: Break tool calls. Check what committed and what the agent claimed.
description: Fault injection for tool-using agents: seeded failures, committed-state grading, replay, a local console, and CI regression checks.
summary: A fault-testing tool for AI agents: break their tool calls, compare their answers with what actually committed, and replay the evidence.

lead.caption: The failure lab after executing the refund experiment. Results come from scripted agents and mock payments; the surrounding Northwind workspace has fictional history.
lead.alt: AgentCrucible's failure lab comparing scripted recovery strategies after a refund commits and its response times out, with tool calls, committed effects, and verdicts.
